title: retain task-family score provenance in developmental history
implementation: For task-family experiments, preserve the verified history-present score schema, evaluator identity, plan/task digests, and output digest in the World-State row and admitted interpretation; verify exact task and invocation-output bindings during writeback. Do not duplicate lineage on every example.
positive_control: Actual fixture-driven acquisition result projects evaluator/task/plan/output identity through World-State and authorized writeback; correct and adverse score rows remain distinct.
negative_control: Writeback rejects substituted task digest or evaluator identity. Private task multiplier/offset/oracle remain absent from World-State projection. Generic non-family suite keeps its prior compact size.

groups.notes: Bounded run passed family acquisition, adverse evidence, restart progression, and interrupted-result recovery; generic suite initially exposed a selected-evidence bound, fixed by limiting score metadata to relevant family rows.

checks.source_hygiene: Changed files decoded as UTF-8; no NUL bytes or trailing whitespace. `git diff --check` is unavailable in this isolated exact-source copy because it has no `.git` metadata.

limitations: task family is operator-declared relevance metadata and does not prove the source outcome is useful or externally observed
fixture inference and deterministic evaluator do not demonstrate real-model acquisition or performance improvement
the result inspector still does not independently reconcile resource-ledger consumption
next_dependency: inspect whether exact evaluator and score lineage survive durable restart and later model-replacement context without gaining current-truth or capability semantics

publication.remote_readback: branch, tree, and changed source blobs verified
